change.summary: The real Chromium empty-state recovery lifecycle now runs at a 390px mobile viewport for List, Tabs, Accordion, Dropdown, Gallery, and Carousel. After keyboard deleting the final row, each test verifies focus returns to that repeater's visible Add action; keyboard Add then focuses the appropriate new field. All six controls remain draft-only, and the same regression continues through explicit Save, reload, and separate Publish.
change.save_publish: Delete and Add remain local draft edits; a later separate explicit Save persists the recovered rows and only the distinct Publish updates the public fixture.
